shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣拎着一串插线板，皱起眉头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a chain of power strips plugged into each other and frowns.
shots.narration: 这一课讲插座、线缆与临时用电。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰把仪器搬到实验室角落，附近没有插座
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves an instrument to a corner of the lab where there is no socket nearby.
shots.narration: 阿杰把仪器搬到没插座的角落。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他把两个插线板串起来，电线横穿过道
shots.prompt_en: He connects two power strips end to end and runs the cord across the walkway.
shots.narration: 两个插线板一串，电线拖过地面。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研差点被电线绊倒，摇头指向墙上的插座
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student nearly trips over the cord, shakes her head and points to a wall socket.
shots.narration: 小研差点绊倒：这样用电不行。

shots.section_title: 插座插线板不超负荷
shots.scene: 插座和插线板旁各有一个空白额定值标牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a socket and a power strip, each with a blank rating plate. No text.
shots.narration: 插座、插线板都有额定功率。

shots.section_title: 插座插线板不超负荷
shots.scene: 一个插线板插满大功率电器，导线发红冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power strip crowded with high power appliances, its cord glowing red and smoking. No text.
shots.narration: 插得太多，电线发热，会起火。

shots.section_title: 插座插线板不超负荷
shots.scene: 功率除以电压等于电流的图示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power icon divided by a voltage icon giving a current icon. No text.
shots.narration: 功率除以220伏，估算电流。

shots.section_title: 插座插线板不超负荷
shots.scene: 电流不超过插线板额定值，打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an estimated current bar staying below the rating mark of a power strip, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 加起来不超过额定值才行。

shots.section_title: 插座插线板不超负荷
shots.scene: 导线、断路器按电流配套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cable and a breaker matched to the current they carry. No text.
shots.narration: 导线和保护器件，按电流选配。

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 烘箱、马弗炉、电热板三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a drying oven, a muffle furnace and a hot plate. No text.
shots.narration: 烘箱、马弗炉，都是大功率。
overlay: 大功率设备用专用插座

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 烘箱插在墙上专用插座，打钩；插在插线板上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oven plugged into its own wall socket with a tick, and plugged into a power strip with a cross. No text.
shots.narration: 用专用插座，不接插线板。

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 一个插座只插一台大功率电器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one socket with only one high power appliance plugged in. No text.
shots.narration: 一个插座，只插一台大功率电器。

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 老周填报修单，老李来加装插座
shots.prompt_en: The older man fills in a blank request form and the facility engineer comes to install a new socket.
shots.narration: 插座不够，报修加装，请人评估。

shots.section_title: 不串接插线板，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 插线板一个接一个串起来，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: power strips plugged into each other in a chain, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 插线板不能一个接一个串着用。
overlay: 不串接插线板，不私拉乱接

shots.section_title: 不串接插线板，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 墙上乱拉的电线、胶布缠的接头，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wires strung messily along a wall with taped joints, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不私拉电线，不乱接插座。

shots.section_title: 不串接插线板，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 阿杰想自己接一盏台灯到线路上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student hand wiring an extra lamp into a cable, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 照明不够也别私接，报修加装。

shots.section_title: 不串接插线板，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 水槽边串接的插线板，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: chained power strips next to a sink, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 水槽边串插排，触电又起火。

shots.section_title: 不串接插线板，不私拉乱接
shots.scene: 持证电工改动线路
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer modifies a circuit while students stand back.
shots.narration: 线路改动，找持证电工。

shots.section_title: 插线板临时用，放干燥处不落地
shots.scene: 长期使用的设备接墙上固定插座，插线板收起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long term instrument connected to a fixed wall socket while a power strip is put away. No text.
shots.narration: 插线板只临时用，不代替布线。
overlay: 插线板临时用，放干燥处不落地

shots.section_title: 插线板临时用，放干燥处不落地
shots.scene: 插线板固定在台面下方干燥处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power strip mounted under a bench in a dry spot. No text.
shots.narration: 插线板放干燥处，别放地上。

shots.section_title: 插线板临时用，放干燥处不落地
shots.scene: 插线板泡在积水旁、被杂物盖住，两个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power strip next to a puddle and another buried under clutter, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 远离水，别被杂物盖住。

shots.section_title: 插线板临时用，放干燥处不落地
shots.scene: 潮湿温室里，防水插座装在高处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a waterproof socket mounted high on the wall of a humid greenhouse. No text.
shots.narration: 潮湿场所，用防水插座和漏保。

shots.section_title: 插线板临时用，放干燥处不落地
shots.scene: 用完拔下插线板，收进抽屉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power strip unplugged after use and put into a drawer. No text.
shots.narration: 临时用完，拔下收好。

shots.section_title: 选用合格产品，认准3C标志
shots.scene: 【实拍】插线板背面铭牌和认证标志特写（遮挡品牌和型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the back of a power strip showing a blank rating label and a certification mark.
shots.narration: 开关插座插线板，认准3C标志。
overlay: 选用合格产品，认准3C标志

shots.section_title: 选用合格产品，认准3C标志
shots.scene: 劣质插线板外壳发黑冒烟，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cheap power strip with a blackened, smoking case, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 劣质插线板，容易发热起火。

shots.section_title: 选用合格产品，认准3C标志
shots.scene: 老周把新的合格插线板发给学生
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands out new certified power strips to students.
shots.narration: 学校统一采购合格产品。

shots.section_title: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合
shots.scene: 【实拍】双手顺着电源线检查外皮，再看插头金属片和根部（未插电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands running along a power cord checking the insulation, then inspecting the plug pins and strain relief.
shots.narration: 用前先查电线和插头。
overlay: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合

shots.section_title: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合
shots.scene: 破皮、露铜、插头松、烧焦四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, cracked insulation, bare copper, a loose plug and a scorch mark. No text.
shots.narration: 破皮、露铜、松动、焦味，都别用。

shots.section_title: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合
shots.scene: 胶布缠破线，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tape wrapped around a damaged cord, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不缠胶布凑合，戴手套也不行。

shots.section_title: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合
shots.scene: 坏线挂停用牌，换上新线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged cord tagged out of service and replaced with a new one. No text.
shots.narration: 停用挂牌，换合格新线。

shots.section_title: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合
shots.scene: 裸线头直接插进插座，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bare wire ends pushed straight into a socket, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 设备都要装插头，裸线头不能插。

shots.section_title: 电线插头用前查，坏了不凑合
shots.scene: 从别处调来的电缆，电工先测绝缘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a borrowed cable reel being tested by an electrician before use. No text.
shots.narration: 调来的电缆，电工先测绝缘。

shots.section_title: 电线不压不夹不拖地，远离热源
shots.scene: 电源线被椅子压住、被门夹住，两个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power cord crushed under a chair leg and pinched in a door, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电线不压、不夹、不穿门缝。
overlay: 电线不压不夹不拖地，远离热源

shots.section_title: 电线不压不夹不拖地，远离热源
shots.scene: 电线横穿走道，人被绊倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cord across a walkway and a person tripping over it. No text.
shots.narration: 电线落地，会绊人、被踩坏。

shots.section_title: 电线不压不夹不拖地，远离热源
shots.scene: 电线走线槽，过道上加护线板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cables run in a cable tray, with a cable protector ramp where they cross a walkway. No text.
shots.narration: 走线槽，过道加护线板。

shots.section_title: 电线不压不夹不拖地，远离热源
shots.scene: 电线贴着电热板，外皮熔化，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cord touching a hot plate, its insulation melting, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电线绕开电热板，别被烫坏。

shots.section_title: 电线不压不夹不拖地，远离热源
shots.scene: 卷线盘没展开就通电发热，旁边展开的打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coiled cable reel heating up when used wound up, crossed out, and a fully unrolled reel with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 卷线盘用前全部展开。

shots.section_title: 插拔插头：先关开关，握住插头
shots.scene: 手先按下设备开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off an instrument before unplugging. No text.
shots.narration: 拔插头前，先关开关。
overlay: 插拔插头：先关开关，握住插头

shots.section_title: 插拔插头：先关开关，握住插头
shots.scene: 【实拍】擦干的手捏住插头本体，从已断电的插座上直拔出来（示范动作）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a dry hand gripping the plug body and pulling it straight out of a switched off socket.
shots.narration: 擦干手，捏住插头往外拔。

shots.section_title: 插拔插头：先关开关，握住插头
shots.scene: 手拽着电线把插头扯出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand yanking the cord to pull out a plug, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别拽电线，会拉断拉松。

shots.section_title: 插拔插头：先关开关，握住插头
shots.scene: 插头插到底；插头松动发烫，挂报修牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plug pushed fully home, and a loose hot plug tagged for repair. No text.
shots.narration: 插头插到底，松了烫了就报修。

shots.section_title: 插拔插头：先关开关，握住插头
shots.scene: 直流电源接头先断负载再插拔，旁边一个小电弧打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a DC connector being unplugged only after the load is switched off, a small arc icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 直流接头，断开负载再插拔。

shots.section_title: 插座接线与导体颜色标识
shots.scene: 三根导线图标：相线、中性线、保护导体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three conductor icons, a line conductor, a neutral conductor and a protective earth conductor. No text.
shots.narration: 导线分相线、零线和保护线。
overlay: 插座接线与导体颜色标识

shots.section_title: 插座接线与导体颜色标识
shots.scene: 面对三孔插座：左零、右火、上接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three hole socket seen from the front, arrows marking left, right and top holes. No text.
shots.narration: 面对插座：左零右火上接地。

shots.section_title: 插座接线与导体颜色标识
shots.scene: 黄绿双色线接在接地端子上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a yellow and green striped wire connected to an earth terminal. No text.
shots.narration: 黄绿双色线，只作保护接地。

shots.section_title: 插座接线与导体颜色标识
shots.scene: 黄绿线被接到相线端子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a yellow and green wire connected to a live terminal, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 黄绿线不能挪作他用。

shots.section_title: 插座接线与导体颜色标识
shots.scene: 颜色图标旁边是验电器，电工先验电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: colored wire icons next to a voltage tester, an electrician testing before touching. No text.
shots.narration: 颜色不能代替验电。

shots.section_title: 插座接线与导体颜色标识
shots.scene: 进口旧仪器电源线交给老李处理
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands an old imported instrument cord to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 换插头、改接线，交持证电工。

shots.section_title: 临时用电与发电机：先报备，电工接线
shots.scene: 便携式发电机图标，内有发动机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a portable generator with an engine inside it. No text.
shots.narration: 便携式发电机，靠发动机发电。
overlay: 临时用电与发电机：先报备，电工接线

shots.section_title: 临时用电与发电机：先报备，电工接线
shots.scene: 触电、废气、起火、噪声四个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four hazard icons around a generator, a shock, exhaust fumes, fire and noise. No text.
shots.narration: 它有触电、废气、火灾、噪声危险。

shots.section_title: 临时用电与发电机：先报备，电工接线
shots.scene: 王老师审批临时用电申请
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews and signs a blank temporary power request.
shots.narration: 临时用电和发电机，先报备审批。

shots.section_title: 临时用电与发电机：先报备，电工接线
shots.scene: 发电机直接接进楼里线路，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator wired straight into a building circuit, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能直接接进楼里的线路。

shots.section_title: 临时用电与发电机：先报备，电工接线
shots.scene: 电器直接插在发电机插座上，专人在旁照看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an appliance plugged directly into the generator outlet, an attendant standing by. No text.
shots.narration: 电器直插发电机，专人照看。

shots.section_title: 发电机：线缆够用、不过载、有漏保、接地
shots.scene: 电工检查发电机配的延长线，坏线打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrician checking the extension cord for a generator, a damaged one crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用带接地的合格三芯线，坏线不用。
overlay: 发电机：线缆够用、不过载、有漏保、接地

shots.section_title: 发电机：线缆够用、不过载、有漏保、接地
shots.scene: 发电机插满电器，机身发红，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator overloaded with appliances, glowing hot, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 线和机器额定值要够，别过载。

shots.section_title: 发电机：线缆够用、不过载、有漏保、接地
shots.scene: 发电机输出端接漏电保护器，再接地线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a residual current device on the generator output and an earth connection. No text.
shots.narration: 输出加漏保，接地良好接头紧。

shots.section_title: 发电机：防潮、防一氧化碳、冷机加油
shots.scene: 雨中露天发电机打叉；四面通风的遮篷下打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator in the rain crossed out, and one under an open sided canopy with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 防雨防潮，湿手湿身不碰。
overlay: 发电机：防潮、防一氧化碳、冷机加油

shots.section_title: 发电机：防潮、防一氧化碳、冷机加油
shots.scene: 泡过水的设备晾干，检查合格才用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flooded device drying out, then passing an inspection. No text.
shots.narration: 泡过水的设备，干燥检查后再用。

shots.section_title: 发电机：防潮、防一氧化碳、冷机加油
shots.scene: 室内和门窗边的发电机，废气飘进屋里，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator indoors and one beside a window, exhaust drifting inside, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不在室内用，远离门窗风口。

shots.section_title: 发电机：防潮、防一氧化碳、冷机加油
shots.scene: 发电机停机冷却后再加油
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator switched off and cooling, then being refuelled slowly. No text.
shots.narration: 停机冷却再加油，运转中不加。

shots.section_title: 宿舍与办公区用电
shots.scene: 宿舍里电热锅、电热毯等违规电器，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: banned appliances in a dormitory such as a hot pot cooker and an electric blanket, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 宿舍不用违规大功率电器。

shots.section_title: 宿舍与办公区用电
shots.scene: 插线板放在床上被子里，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power strip lying on a bed under a quilt, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 插线板不放床上，充电不过夜。

shots.section_title: 宿舍与办公区用电
shots.scene: 离开宿舍，阿杰拔掉插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student unplugs his devices before leaving his dorm room.
shots.narration: 离开宿舍和办公室，拔掉插头。

shots.section_title: 宿舍与办公区用电
shots.scene: 宿舍墙上的用电规定图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dormitory wall with a blank rules poster and an electric plug icon. No text.
shots.narration: 遵守学校宿舍用电规定。
